probes.question: Neither the teacher nor the students _____ aware of the change.
probes.explanation_en: With "neither...nor", the verb commonly agrees with the nearer subject. Here "students" is plural, so "were" is correct.
probes.explanation_bn: "neither...nor"-এ verb সাধারণত কাছের subject-এর সঙ্গে agree করে। এখানে "students" plural, তাই "were" সঠিক।
probes.rationale: The anchor has singular "teacher" as the nearer subject. The probe reverses the order so plural "students" becomes nearer while keeping the construction and meaning nearly identical.

probes.question: He is _____ honest person.
probes.explanation_en: The "h" in "honest" is silent, so the word begins with a vowel sound. Use "an".
probes.explanation_bn: "honest" শব্দের "h" উচ্চারিত হয় না, তাই শব্দটি vowel sound দিয়ে শুরু হয়। সেজন্য "an" ব্যবহার হবে।
probes.rationale: The anchor tests "a" before "university", which begins with a consonant sound. This probe tests transfer to a silent-h word beginning with a vowel sound.

probes.question: She left without _____ goodbye.
probes.explanation_en: After the preposition "without", use the -ing form here: "saying".
probes.explanation_bn: Preposition "without"-এর পরে এখানে -ing form ব্যবহার হবে: "saying"।
probes.rationale: The anchor uses "look forward to hearing", where "to" functions as a preposition. This probe tests the same pattern after the ordinary preposition "without".

probes.question: Which thesis statement is the clearest for an opinion essay about remote work?
options: Remote work has many advantages and disadvantages.
Companies should adopt hybrid work because it preserves flexibility while supporting collaboration.
Remote work is becoming more popular.
I think remote work is good.
probes.explanation_en: Option B gives a clear position and focused supporting reasons. The other options are too broad, descriptive, or vague.
probes.explanation_bn: B বিকল্পটি একটি স্পষ্ট অবস্থান ও নির্দিষ্ট supporting reason দেয়। অন্য বিকল্পগুলো খুব সাধারণ, বর্ণনামূলক বা অস্পষ্ট।
probes.rationale: The anchor asks the learner to identify a focused thesis on another topic. This probe preserves the same recognition task while changing the topic.
